test_check_cpu_flags: test the check_cpu_flags function with all required CPU features present and no warnings
test_check_cpu_flags_missing_features: test the check_cpu_flags function when a required CPU feature is missing and emits a warning
test_check_cpu_flags_unknown_flag: test the check_cpu_flags function with an unknown feature flag and raises a RuntimeError
test_check_cpu_flags_skipped_no_flags: test the check_cpu_flags function with an empty flag string skips CPU flag reading
test_check_cpu_flags_skipped_env_var: test the check_cpu_flags function skips CPU check when POLARS_SKIP_CPU_CHECK env var is set
